content: Geegwarahchįį Dąį' Ch'ara'aa Gwarahtsii Gwagwandak Haa Geech'ǫąąhtan.
Jesus, chan hee gwandak ąhtsii zhit geech'ǫąąhtan haa dinjii nąįį ts'ą' ginkhii.
“Zheekat Gweegwinii'ee t'ee jyaa doonchy'aa. Ch'ihłan k'eedeegwaadhat choo (King) didinji' goohaanjik geenjit ch'arehee'aa gwahtsii.
Ditsyaa nąįį ąįį juu ineech'ehił'al nąįį aanaii goovohnyąą nyąą, gaa oo'ee gwarǫh'ya' giindhan kwaa.

Ąįįts'ą' t'ee ch'izhii ditsyaa haa neech'idiin'ąįį juu ineech'ahah'aa nąįį jyaa dagahaanjyaa geenjit, ‘It'ee ch'arehee'aa: sha-aak'ii ts'ą' aak'ii gii tthąį' nizįį kwaii khadiriint'uu ts'ą' datthak shragwaazhit. Nihłeegwarahchįį ch'arehee'aa, aanaii.’ goovaihnyąą nyąą.
Gaa juu ineech'ehił'al nąįį gwats'ą' tr'ahoojyaa giindhan kwaa ts'ą' digwigwitr'it gineegiitii. Ch'ihłak gwanzhįh deek'it gwats'ą' haazhii, ts'ą' ch'izhii chan dach'arookwat zheh gwats'ą' haazhii.
Gwiizhit ch'izhii nąįį k'eedeegwaadhat choo vitsyaa nąįį ahtsik ts'ą' googahkhwąį' ts'ą' goovęhdaa tr'igwiin'ąįį.
(King) k'eedeegwaadhat choo łyaa zhyants'įį, ąįįts'ą' diniveet'ah'in nąįį oo'an hił'e'. Juu dinjii aghan nąįį ęhdaa tr'igwigwehee'aa ts'ą' goo-kwaiik'it gwachoo neegwagwahahk'an geenjit.
Ąįįtł'ęę ditsyaa nąįį aanaii ahnyąą ts'ą' jyaa dagoovahnyąą, ‘It'ee nihłeegwarahchįį ch'arehee'aa, gaa ąįį juu ineech'ahał'aa nąįį duuyeh gooneech'ał'aa.
It'ee oo'at tąįį gwinjik gwinchyaa gwa'an dinjii lęįį nąįį dzaa gwats'ą' hohjyaa ts'ą' ch'oh'aa goovohnyąą.’ nyąą.

Ąįįts'ą' t'ee vitsyaa nąįį oo'at tąįį gwinjik gwa'an dinjii lęįį khaihłan nigiinlii, dinjii nizįį ts'ą' dinjii iizųų haa nihk'it ts'ą' nihłeegwarahchįį ch'arehee'aa zheh gwizhit dinjii deedąą'ąį' goodlit.
“(King) k'eedeegwaadhat choo oozhat gwizhit juu ineech'ahah'aa nąįį nah'in akhai' dinjii ch'ihłak nihłeegwarahahchyaa geenjit needeegwaazhii kwaa łee nah'in.
‘Shijyaa, nihłeegwarahchįį geenjit needeegwanzhii kwaa gwiizhit nats'ahts'ą' dzaa nihdeiinzhii?’ yahnyąą ts'ą' (King) k'eedeegwaadhat choo yuahkat. Gaa ąįį dinjii yidii ginkhii kwaa.

Tł'ęę t'ee k'eedeegwaadhat choh (King) ditsyaa nąįį jyaa dahnyąą. ‘Jii dinjii vanli' ts'ą' vakwai' haa dohchyaa ts'ą' chiitąįį tǫǫ gwats'ą' cheet'eehohkhii. Izhit t'ee gwintł'oo heetree ts'ą' dagho' nihts'ą' łǫǫn'al haa neeyik'ii k'it t'ihee'yaa.’” yahnyąą.
Ts'ą' Jesus ndaanich'igįįnkhee, “Lęįį nąįį aanaii arahnyąą, gaa nitsya' zhrįh gwitee tr'iriinlii t'oonchy'aa.” nyąą.
Taxes Tr'ooheekwat Gach'oogwaahkat
Pharisee nąįį gihłeegahoojil ts'ą' nats'ąą Jesus goohahkat haa goodhaii nigiihahthal geenjit geegiginkhii.

Tł'ęę t'ee digitsyaa lat nąįį ts'ą' Herod vitsyaa lat nąįį haa giits'ą' hił'e'. Jyaa digiiyahnyąą, “Geech'ǫąąhtan, łi'didlii haa geech'ǫąąhtan naagwiindaii. Dinjii nąįį łi'didlii haa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa deegoo'ya' gavoonyąą ąįį gwik'it t'igihee'yaa geenjit geegoovąąhtan. Jidii k'it t'inchy'aa dinjii giinlii ąįį gwiinchyaa kwaa geh'an dinjii nąįį nats'ahts'ą' ninjich'agadhat ąįį geenjit tr'igwiindii kwaa.
Diihaa gwandak, Caesar, Rome nahkat gwats'ą' k'eedeegwaadhat, vats'a' taxes tr'ookwat ji' dii-law inehts'į' t'igwii'in lee t'igwii'in? Googwarahookwat kwaa akwat googwarahookwat, jidii shrit?”
Jesus ąįį giits'ą' gwiizųų t'igihee'yaa gwik'eegogwandaii goovaandaii ts'ą' t'inyąą, “Gwik'injiighit adaa'įį nąįį! Jaghaii gwiizųų t'ihihjyaa ji' geenjit, goodhaii nashahohthal gwik'eegǫhdaii?
Ąįį laraa ghoo tsal (silver) noił'ya'!” Ąįįts'ą' laraa ghoo tsal giiyantł'eiin'ąįį,
ts'ą' goovahkat, “Juu vinin ts'ą' voozhri' haa vakat dha'aii?”
“Caesar's reh,” ginyąą. Ąįįts'ą' Jesus t'agoovahnyąą, “Akwaa ji' Caesar jidii vats'an nilii haa vagohkwat ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa jidii vats'an nilii haa vagohkwat.”
Nijin jii gwigwiitth'ak dąį', deegiheenjyaa gaa gaagiindaii kwaa, ts'ą' akhagiiyuunyąą ts'ą' giihłeehoojil.
Niriindhat Gwats'an Neegwiriindaii Eenjit Gach'agwaahkat.
Zhat drin Sadducee lat nąįį nineegwaalii kwaa ginyąą ts'ą' Jesus ts'ą' gahaajil ts'ą' giiyųąhkat.

“Geech'ǫąąhtan, Moses jii Law diineenjit diyaantł'oo, dinjii niindhat gwiizhit vigii kwaa gaa va'at gwanlii ji' ąįį vachaa, doondee'at nooheendal ts'ą' tr'iinin gihee'yaa ąįį ch'oondee vigii k'it dink'igiihahthaa.
Ch'ihłan nihchaa 7 nąįį gwanlii; ch'oondee ąįį tr'injaa oonjik ts'ą' vigii kwaa gwiizhit niindhat, dachaa nąįį ts'ą' da'at akhoonyąą.
Ąįįtł'ęę vachaa yats'ąįį ya'at noonjik, ts'ą' gwats'ąįį ch'achaa chan gwik'it t'iizhik, ndaagwąą'ąį' dąį' nihchaa 7 nąįį datthak neegiiyuunjik gaa googii kwaa ts'ą' nigiinjik.
Ąįįtł'ęę ąįį tr'injaa chan niindhat.
Nijin drin niindhat nąįį neegogwandaii neegahoodlit nigwiindhat ji' nihchaa 7 datthak neegiiyuunjik ts'ą' juu zhrįh va'at heelyaa t'inchy'aa,” giiyahnyąą.
Gaa Jesus goodii ginkhii, “Dęhtły'aa Choo zhit deegwinyąą akwat Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vat'aii jiintsii kwaii gaakhwandaii kwaa geh'an gwinzii dohnyąą kwaa t'oonchy'aa.
Nigiindhat gwats'an neegwigwiindaii nąįį izhit ji' zheekat Gwich'in k'it t'igiheechy'aa ts'ą' nihłagooheendal kwaa t'oonchy'aa.
ts'ą' Dęhtły'aa Choo kat nik'ee nigiindhat gwats'an neegwigwiindaii gwinyąą gooh'in ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa jii jyaa nyąą,
‘Shįį t'ee Abraham, Isaac ts'ą' Jacob haa Goovit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ihłii.’ nyąą, niindhat nąįį eenjit Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa nilii kwaa gaa gwandaii nąįį eenjit gwizhrįh Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa nilii.”
Jesus łyaa gooveenjit geegwaroolii kwaa, geech'ǫąąhtan.
Moses Va-law Zhit Jidii Shrit Ch'andaa Jiintsii
Nijin Jesus, Sadducee nąįį deegiheenjyaa gaagiindaii kwaa gooviłtsąįį dąį', Pharisee nąįį gwigwiitth'ak ts'ą' datthak nihłaa khaihłak gaadlit,
ts'ą' gootee ch'ihłak, Law geech'ǫąąhtan nilii ąįį goodhaii niyahahtthal geenjit yuahkat,
“Geech'ǫąąhtan, jidii Moses va-law zhrįh ch'andaa jiintsii t'oonchy'aa?” yahnyąą.
Jesus t'iiyahnyąą, “‘K'eegwaadhat Nivit'eegwijyąhchy'aa nidrii datthak, ts'ą' nizhin datthak, ts'ą' niyinji' datthak haa veet'ihiinghyaa goo'aii!’
Jii t'ee tr'ookit jyaa digwehee'yaa gwinyąą ąįį jiintsii nilii t'inchy'aa.
Gwats'ąįį chan vik'it t'iiyiinchy'aa, ‘Deegwahtł'oo ideet'iindhan googwahtł'oo ninee'ok dinjii nąįį datthak eet'ihiinghyaa goo'aii.’
Ąįį gwik'it Moses va-law datthak, ts'ą' Dęhtły'aa Choh zhit Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Eenjit Ginkhii nąįį jidii eech'agǫąąhtan datthak jii law neekwaii ts'an t'ee gwizhrįh gwit'eegaahchy'aa t'oonchy'aa.”
Messiah (Christ), Eenjit Ch'agoahkat
Nijin Pharisee nąįį nihłaa nineegeejil dąį' Jesus gavaahkat,
“Christ eenjit deeyųųhthan? Juu ts'an neezheeneedijii t'inchy'aa.” yahnyąą. “Yeenii King David vizhehk'aa gwats'an ahaa t'inchy'aa,” giiyahnyąą.
Jesus gavahkat, “Akwaa ji' jaghaii, Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą zhit King David Shik'eegwaadhat yahnyąą?” Dęhtły'aa Choo zhit David jii jyaa nyąą,

content.text: dahthee juu nits'į' t'inchy'aa nąįį nakwai' t'eh nihihłyaa gwats'ą' datthak.’ yahnyąą.

content: King David, adan gaa Shik'eegwaadhat yahnyąą gwiizhit nats'ahts'ą' Christ ąįį yeenii David ts'an diheedhaa?” Jesus gavahnyąą.
Ch'ihłak gaa Jesus deegahaanjyaa gaagiindaii kwaa, ąįį zhit drin gwats'an giiyuuhaahkat gwits'į' adak'agaantii.
